## Summary

- What changed?
- What user problem does it solve?

## Verification

- [ ] `make lint typecheck test check-package`
- [ ] `make qt-smoke`, when UI or Qt behavior changed
- [ ] Manual behavior checked in a supported Anki version, when applicable

## Safety

- [ ] The change does not read, upload, edit, or reschedule Anki collection data.
- [ ] The change does not modify card templates or AnkiHub-owned views.
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Screenshots contain no card, account, or sign-in data.

## Screenshots

Include before and after images for visible interface changes.
